creator.name: Wren
creator.promise: Calm, honest grooming for anxious dogs, filmed the way I wish other groomers did.

sections.title: Who and why
sections.line: Written from the interview. Every script, hook and title is checked against it.
text: Wren runs a one-chair grooming studio in Austin. The channel exists because grooming videos online look loud and rushed, and nervous dogs deserve better.
For: owners of anxious dogs, and groomers who want a calmer way to work.
list: Feel: entertaining first, then useful
How far she'll go: her face on camera, her own clients' dogs (with permission), no fake rescues

sections.title: Images and likeness
sections.line: How generated pictures may show her.
list: Generated pictures show her subject, not her, unless she approves a likeness brief first
Reference photos: 2 of 9 sent (face straight on, smiling); 7 still owed, all optional

sections.title: House rules
sections.line: Every no, with its reason. They bind every video.
list: No neon: it reads as a nightclub, not a studio
No bouncy text: it feels childish for nervous owners
No stock music with vocals under talking

highlights: Highlights only. The full brand, including every library, research default and rule, is in Brand Genome.md in your brand folder. Every video skill reads that file.
